label: Prepared dish
description: Named savory dishes from world cuisines, including soups, salads, breakfasts, street food, and main courses.
notes: Savory prepared dishes belong here; food.dessert holds sweets and baked goods, and food.drink holds beverages. Values use recognizable dish names that follow “a serving of,” with visual glosses for browsing. Cuisine chips are culinary groupings; region tags mark associations rather than exclusive origins, and Mediterranean dishes can span several regions. Meal tags overlap where a dish serves several roles; tiers reflect expected food imagery rather than cultural importance.
